# Branz Mega Kuningan Jakarta

> Branz Mega Kuningan is a 482-unit Japanese-engineered luxury condominium in Mega Kuningan CBD, Jakarta Selatan, developed by Tokyu Land Indonesia (Tokyu Fudosan Holdings, Japan). Constructed by Shimizu Corporation (Japan, founded 1804). Interior by Field Four Design Office (Japan). Managed by Tokyu Property Management Indonesia (~822,000 units managed in Japan). Funded by JOIN (Japan Overseas Infrastructure Investment Corporation, 6.5 billion yen). Handover commenced 2 December 2024 — ready to occupy. Sales above 80%. Pet-friendly. Free PPN 12% promo on selected units. 88 floors including Technical Floor 44. Unit types: Studio, 1BR-A (±63/52 sqm), 1BR-C 1BR+1 (±80/64 sqm), 2BR-A (±74/60 sqm), 2BR-B (±80/64 sqm), 3BR (±136/110 sqm). Low Zone 12-17F: 26 units/floor. Mid/High Zone 18-88F: 14 units/floor. Ground retail: Kem Chicks, Burma, Annathaya Wellness. Swissotel Living Jakarta Mega Kuningan (Accor, 240 serviced apartments). Contact: 081882888199 · info@jakartaapartments.co
